answer: Each account's quote from a confidential VM must bind its account key and an epoch nonce; the verifier admits at most 4 accounts per chip ID in the vendor-signed certificate per epoch. Cost: $0.60 per chip-epoch at an assumed $0.10 per chip-hour, i.e. $0.15 per account, linear in n, if the agent must run inside the VM for 6 h. Cheapest bypass: bulk rental, e.g. in a Mesa datacenter, or an owned chip whose key is extracted to forge quotes. The vault of vendor roots is the trust anchor; TEE-less agents are excluded.
